name: Robe of Stilled Thought
notes: Made by Ssivanak herself. Significant item — effectively frees concentration slot while one spell runs autonomously.
effect: One concentration spell cast while wearing this robe does not require concentration — it runs for its full duration or until dismissed. Only one spell benefits at a time. Casting a second concentration spell ends the first immediately.

name: Bracers of Spell Mastery
effect: +2 to spell save DC.
notes: Intended for Elucyne to enhance Fear and other save-based spells.

name: Scroll of Control Water
effect: Cast Control Water (level 4). Single use.
notes: Immediately relevant for ocean travel and combat.

name: Scroll of Lightning Bolt
effect: Cast Lightning Bolt (level 3). Single use.
notes: Included free by Ssivanak to close the deal.

name: Scroll of Greater Invisibility
effect: Cast Greater Invisibility (level 4). Single use.

name: Scroll of Plane Shift
effect: Cast Plane Shift (level 7). Single use.
notes: Given free by Ssivanak in exchange for Jaygar identifying it. Inscription was deliberately damaged by previous owner to obscure contents.

name: Scroll of Sending
effect: Cast Sending once. Deliver a 25 word message to any creature on the same plane. Target can reply.
notes: Received as part of Ssivanak's Stillwater reward.

name: Scroll of Counterspell
effect: Cast Counterspell once. Interrupt a creature casting a spell of 3rd level or lower automatically. Higher levels require ability check.
notes: Received as part of Ssivanak's Stillwater reward.

name: Brooch of Shielding
effect: Resistance to force damage. Immunity to Magic Missile.
notes: Given by Ssivanak as part of Stillwater reward, her choice of item.

name: Potion of Greater Healing
effect: Restores 4d4+4 HP. Bonus action to self-administer.

name: Potion of Greater Healing
effect: Restores 4d4+4 HP. Bonus action to self-administer.

name: Potion of Greater Healing
effect: Restores 4d4+4 HP. Bonus action to self-administer.

name: Potion of Greater Healing
effect: Restores 4d4+4 HP. Bonus action to self-administer.

name: Potion of Greater Healing (Measured Word formulation)
effect: Restores 4d4+4 HP with advantage on the roll. Bonus action to self-administer.

name: Potion of Greater Healing (Measured Word formulation)
effect: Restores 4d4+4 HP with advantage on the roll. Bonus action to self-administer.

name: Potion of Superior Healing
effect: Restores 8d4+8 HP. Bonus action to self-administer.

name: Potion of Superior Healing
effect: Restores 8d4+8 HP. Bonus action to self-administer.

name: Amulet of Restoration
effect: Healing Word can be cast twice per short rest, recovered automatically.
notes: Pale green oval stone on silver chain. Carved with unidentified script.

name: Lexica's Enchanted Instrument
description: A lyre-like instrument of unusual construction, typical of no known tradition on Kaemahz. Acquired from a travelling vendor at the Halfweek Festival. One of two such instruments held by the same vendor. Dark wood with unfamiliar inlays, the resonance fuller than the size suggests.
effect: While Bardic Inspiration is active on a creature, the wielder may use their reaction to cast Shield on that creature or on herself.
notes: Enchanted by DUVRAK, Upper Merchant Quarter, Argentveil.

name: Ring of the Knowing
description: Simple band of dark metal of unknown continental origin. Single flat face bearing a symbol worn almost to suggestion by time. Warm to the touch. Eleven years in Ossivane Relk's possession before purchase.
effect: Once per day the wearer may ask one specific, answerable question. The answer arrives in the wearer's own voice as though remembered rather than received. Answers are truthful. The ring occasionally volunteers additional relevant information beyond the question asked — treat this as significant. Questions must be specific: a location, a name, a fact. Abstract questions yield nothing.
notes: Purchased from Ossivane Relk, Linden Street Antiquities Market, Argentveil. Day 89, Year 468. Cost 12,000 gold. Origin unknown — metal not from Kaemahz. Pre-existing symbol unidentified. First use: located factor's man Davan (green coat) to Crestfall House, Seventeen Anchor Row. Ring volunteered 'he is not alone' unprompted. Second use pending.

name: Cold Valley Axe
effect: On attunement: wielder gains the Smite From Afar spell (homebrew, 1st-level Paladin).

name: Breastplate of Planes
effect: On attunement: advantage on concentration saving throws.

name: Shield +2
notes: Standard shield, +2 enhancement.
effect: +2 bonus to AC while carried.

name: Disc of Origin
notes: Oldest of the four. Heavier than the others, different stone. Angular markings read 'breath of the first wind.'
effect: When placed in a teleportation arch, keys the arch to the ruins northeast of Valdmere.

name: Disc of the Unnamed Plane
notes: Middle weight, old. Markings identify a destination neither Lenn nor Ilwuoshim recognized.
effect: When placed in a teleportation arch, keys the arch to an unknown, uncharted destination.

name: Disc of the Junction
notes: Lightest of the four. Markings identify it as a waypoint between two others.
effect: When placed in a teleportation arch, keys the arch to a waypoint hub built between two other arches — a transit point rather than a final destination.

name: Disc of Ilwuoshim's Second Arch
notes: Ilwuoshim's own making, identified by the djinn personally. Ilwuoshim wishes to visit when free. Keep safe.
effect: When placed in a teleportation arch, keys to an arch built by Ilwuoshim before the Liliveth was completed — never previously used.

name: Ring of Amity
effect: Once per long rest, attune to one willing creature within reach. Any healing you receive is also received by the bonded creature for the same amount. Once per day as a reaction (within 60 ft), turn any attack roll the bonded creature makes into a critical hit.

name: Longbow
effect: Standard longbow. 1d8 piercing. Range 150/600ft. Requires two hands.

name: Scroll of Tongues
effect: Cast Tongues (level 3). Single use. Target understands and is understood in any language for 1 hour.

name: Bright Red Cloak
effect: +1 to CHA score.
notes: Bright red. Custom-fitted.

name: Stormcaller's Cutlass
effect: +1 to attack and damage rolls. Once per day, channel a strike that adds 2d6 lightning damage on a hit, accompanied by a genuine thunderclap loud enough to be heard across the deck.

weapon_effects.name: Stormcaller's Strike
weapon_effects.description: On a hit, deal an extra 2d6 lightning damage, accompanied by a thunderclap loud enough to be heard across the deck.

name: Poison Shortsword +1
effect: +1 to attack and damage rolls. On a hit: extra 1d4 poison damage. Target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute.

weapon_effects.name: Poison Strike
weapon_effects.description: On a hit, deal an extra 1d4 poison damage. Target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute.

name: Wolf Hunter's Rags
effect: While worn: the wearer gives off no scent and cannot be tracked by scent. The wearer cannot be detected, targeted, or perceived by divination magic (as per the nondetection spell).

name: Breastplate of the Broken Scale
notes: Recovered from an ancient battlefield beside dragon remains in a ravine.
effect: AC 14 + DEX modifier (max 2). Stormbreak Reserve: whenever the wearer takes 15 or more damage from a single attack or effect, the armor stores one charge (max 1 stored, tracked via charges above). As a bonus action, release a stored charge: 10ft radius force burst centered on self, 2d6 force damage (DC 15 DEX save for half) to all other creatures in range, each creature that fails is pushed 10ft away. Recharges automatically on the next qualifying hit.

name: Gauntlet of the Sundering Blow
notes: Recovered from the same ancient battlefield as the Breastplate of the Broken Scale; matching set.
effect: Sundering Strike: once per short rest, as part of a melee attack that hits, channel the gauntlet — the attack deals an additional 2d6 damage, and the target's AC is reduced by 2 until the end of the wearer's next turn.

name: Hand Crossbow of the Old Trail
notes: Recovered from a territorial Dire Pangolin's den.
effect: +2 to attack and damage rolls. Marked Shot: once per short rest, when firing a bolt, choose one rider effect: (a) target must succeed on a Constitution save or have speed halved until the end of its next turn, or (b) wielder gains advantage on their next attack roll against that target within 1 minute.

weapon_effects.name: Marked Shot
weapon_effects.description: On a hit, choose one: the target makes a Constitution save or has its speed halved until the end of its next turn, or you gain advantage on your next attack roll against that target within 1 minute.

name: Signet Ring
notes: Unidentified origin/bloodline — foreign craftsmanship, doesn't match Fol, Fynesmarch, or Torwald design conventions seen so far. Found on remains inside a territorial Dire Pangolin's den.
effect: Warding Press: once per long rest, press the ring to your skin to gain resistance to one damage type of your choice for 1 hour.

name: Stone of the Rootbound Ward
notes: Paired item — see Stone of the Broken Vein (Eldi) for the shared combo ability, The Stones Agree. Devised by someone untrained in the power it channels — see Attuned Stone Backlash (homebrew rule).
effect: Mold Earth (cantrip, 3/day): as the spell — reshape a 5-ft cube of nonmagical dirt or stone (raise, lower, excavate, or sculpt it); can't affect worked or magical stone, can't harm creatures. Wall of Stone (5th-level spell, 1/day): as the spell — conjure up to ten interlocking 10-ft-by-10-ft stone panels (6in thick, AC 15, 180 HP each), or 10-ft-by-20-ft panels at half thickness (3in, 90 HP each); must merge with and be supported by existing stone, spans over 20ft require halving panel size for support. Concentration, up to 10 minutes (can be made permanent by concentrating the full duration). This is the same charge that powers The Stones Agree (see homebrew spells) — spending it on one makes the other unavailable until the next long rest. Passive: tremorsense 30ft while attuned and touching the ground. Active uses (Mold Earth, Wall of Stone, The Stones Agree) trigger the Attuned Stone Backlash — DC 12 CON save or 1d6 damage. Passive tremorsense does not trigger it.

name: Stone of the Broken Vein
notes: Paired item — see Stone of the Rootbound Ward (Rith) for the shared combo ability, The Stones Agree. Devised by someone untrained in the power it channels — see Attuned Stone Backlash (homebrew rule).
effect: Spike Growth (2nd-level spell, reflavored as jagged stone rather than thorns, 3/day): as the spell — ground in a 20-ft-radius sphere becomes difficult terrain; a creature moving into or within the area takes 2d4 piercing damage for every 5ft traveled (no save). Concentration, up to 10 minutes. Erupting Earth (3rd-level spell, 1/day): as the spell — choose a point on the ground within range; a 20-ft cube of churned earth and stone erupts there. Each creature in the area makes a DEX save (DC 15, fixed rather than derived from the bearer's own stats) — 3d12 bludgeoning damage on a failure, half on success. The area becomes difficult terrain until cleared (1 minute per 5-ft square, by hand). Instantaneous — no concentration required. This is the same charge that powers The Stones Agree (see homebrew spells) — spending it on one makes the other unavailable until the next long rest. Passive: tremorsense 30ft while attuned and touching the ground. Active uses (Spike Growth, Erupting Earth, The Stones Agree) trigger the Attuned Stone Backlash — DC 12 CON save or 1d6 damage. Passive tremorsense does not trigger it.

name: Purple Ribbed Leather +2
notes: Purchased from Vethran & Son, Commerce District, Argentveil. Base AC 12 (studded-leather tier, reflavored as ribbed rather than studded), no DEX cap. Distinctive purple dye — the shopkeeper was glad to be rid of it.
effect: +2 bonus to AC from armor.

name: Staff of the Wild's Balance
notes: A gift from Orrin, ancient tortle caretaker of the Verdant Hollow, Argentveil. Recovered from a sealed cache predating the city itself. Qualifies for Wild Symbiosis (wood construction).
effect: Acts as a +1 quarterstaff and druidic focus. While attuned, +1 to druid spell attack rolls and spell save DC. While in Wild Shape, grants Primal Surge (see homebrew features).

name: Paired Shortsword +2
notes: Previously +1, upgraded to +2 by the enchantress in Valdmere.
effect: +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls. Resonance only works with Denna's paired sword.

name: Laminated Marking Shortbow +1
effect: +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. Once per combat, the bearer may declare a ranged attack with this bow to be a marking shot before rolling, forcing Faerie Fire onto the target with no save (single target only, not the spell's usual area).

weapon_effects.name: Marking Shot
weapon_effects.description: Once per combat, before rolling, the bearer may declare a ranged attack with this bow to be a marking shot. The target is immediately affected by Faerie Fire — no save, single target only (not the spell's usual 20-foot cube).
